title: Tech Saturn Mar.1997: Okaeshi wa? Marshmallow, Cookie, Howaito Choco
native_title: ＴＥＣＨ ＳＡＴＵＲＮ ＭＡＲ．１９９７ お返しは？ ①マシュマロ ②クッキー ③ホワイトチョコ
overview: Tech Saturn Mar. 1997 is the Sega Saturn CD-ROM that came packed in a sleeve inside the March 1997 issue of Tech Saturn, ASCII's Saturn magazine. Each issue's disc mixed trial versions of Saturn games with original content made by the magazine's own staff.
